description:
This season revolves around Changan City in the Honor of Kings continent, starting with the newcomer Yun Ying joining the Dali Temple. She and Li Yuanfang team up to carry out missions, gradually unveiling the mysteries of the Yao Tian organization. Although the members of the Dali Temple and the Yao Tian organization belong to different factions, they are all protecting Changan and pursuing their own sense of justice in their own ways.

(Source: Tencent, translated, edited)
